body:
Welcome and thanks for contributing!

This seems to be a good change, but some further work might be needed to make it merge ready.

- This modifies the PC export code (Windows/Linux), but there might be similar logic in other platform exporters. It would be good to review them and see (at least Web in `platform/web/export/export_plugin.cpp` has the exact same pattern, and I see Windows/Linux have similar stuff in their further specified `export_project` methods).
- The commit message should be amended to be clearer about what it's doing. See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#format-your-commit-messages-with-readability-in-mind for details.
